arxiv-2011-13410.title: Can Copper Nanostructures Sustain High-Quality Plasmons?
arxiv-2011-13410.creator: Vahagn Mkhitaryan, Katia March, Eric Tseng, Xiaoyan Li, Leonardo Scarabelli, Luis M. Liz-Marzán, Shih-Yun Chen, Luiz H. G. Tizei, Odile Stéphan, Jenn-Ming Song, Mathieu Kociak, F. Javier García de Abajo, Alexandre Gloter
arxiv-2011-13410.description: Abstract Silver is considered to be the king among plasmonic materials because it features low inelastic absorption in the visible and infrared (vis-IR) spectral regions compared to other metals. In contrast, copper is commonly regarded as being too lossy for plasmonic applications.

arxiv-2104-09344.title: Finding Closure Terms Directly from Coarse Data for 2D Turbulent Flow
arxiv-2104-09344.creator: Xianyang Chen, Jiacai Lu, Grétar Tryggvason
arxiv-2104-09344.description: Abstract Machine learning is used to develop closure terms for coarse grained model of two-dimensional turbulent flow directly from the coarse grained data by adding a source term to the Navier-Stokes equations to ensure that the coarse-grained flow evolves in the correct way.

arxiv-2202-07538.title: Orientated energy absorption from mid-infrared laser pulses in constrained water systems
arxiv-2202-07538.creator: Rong-Yao Yang, Wei-Zhou Jiang, Pei-Ying Huo
arxiv-2202-07538.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Rong-Yao Yang, Wei-Zhou Jiang, Pei-Ying Huo. The energy acquisition based on resonant excitations are of great importance in chemical and biological systems. Here, the intramolecular resonant absorption of polarized mid-infrared pulses by bulk water and surface water is investigated using molecular dynamics simulation.

arxiv-2210-01696.title: Clean self-supervised MRI reconstruction from noisy, sub-sampled training data with Robust SSDU
arxiv-2210-01696.creator: Charles Millard, Mark Chiew
arxiv-2210-01696.description: Abstract Most existing methods for Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) reconstruction with deep learning use fully supervised training, which assumes that a high signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), fully sampled dataset is available for training. In many circumstances, however, such a dataset is highly impractical or even technically infeasible to acquire.

arxiv-2212-01948.title: A computation of the covariance between two linear statistics for the Jellium model
arxiv-2212-01948.creator: Pete Rigas
arxiv-2212-01948.description: Abstract We extend previous results providing an exact formula for the variance of a linear statistic for the Jellium model, a one-dimensional model of Statistical mechanics obtained from the k ⟶ 0 + k\longrightarrow 0^{+} limit of the Dyson log-gas.

arxiv-2301-09035.title: Violation of the orbital depairing limit in a non-unitary state –on the high field phase in the heavy Fermion superconductor UTe 2 –
arxiv-2301-09035.creator: Kazushige Machida
arxiv-2301-09035.description: Abstract A theoretical study is reported on the origin of extremely high upper critical field ∼ \sim 70T observed in UTe 2 with the transition temperature T c =1.6K-2K, far exceeding the conventional orbital depairing limit set by the Fermi velocity and T c for a superconductor (SC) in the clean limit.

arxiv-2402-01699.title: Intergenerational Preferences and Continuity: Reconciling Order and Topology
arxiv-2402-01699.creator: A. Estevan, R.R. Maura, O. Valero
arxiv-2402-01699.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by A. Estevan, R.R. Maura, O. Valero. In this paper we focus our efforts on studying how a preorder and topology can be made compatible. Thus we provide a characterization of those that are continuous-compatible. Such a characterization states that such topologies must be finer than the so-called upper topology induced by the preorder and, thus, it clarifies which topology is the smallest one among those that make the preorder continuous.

arxiv-2407-19916.title: Aero-Nef: Neural Fields for Rapid Aircraft Aerodynamics Simulations
arxiv-2407-19916.creator: Giovanni Catalani, Siddhant Agarwal, Xavier Bertrand, Frederic Tost, Michael Bauerheim, Joseph Morlier 1. Airbus2. ISAE-Supaero, ToulouseCorresponding email: giovanni.catalani@airbus.com
arxiv-2407-19916.description: Abstract This paper presents a methodology to learn surrogate models of steady state fluid dynamics simulations on meshed domains, based on Implicit Neural Representations (INRs). The proposed models can be applied directly to unstructured domains for different flow conditions, handle non-parametric 3D geometric variations, and generalize to unseen shapes at test time.

arxiv-2410-00532.title: smICA: an open source repository for mapping the concentration of fluorescently labeled molecules in living cells on the basis of
arxiv-2410-00532.creator: confocal imaging combined with time-correlated single-photon counting
arxiv-2410-00532.description:
A 2024 arXiv research paper by confocal imaging combined with time-correlated single-photon counting. Abstract

Advanced microscopy techniques are essential for visualizing and tracking cellular components and molecules in biomedical
research. However, conventional fluorescence microscopy methods often struggle with accurately measuring molecule concentrations
in cells. To overcome these limitations, we introduce a novel approach that integrates laser scanning confocal microscopy with
time-correlated single photon counting (TCSPC), supported by an open-source analysis tool called smICA (single-molecule Image to
Concentration Analyzer).

The management of chronic heart failure presents significant challenges in modern healthcare, requiring continuous monitoring, early detection of exacerbations, and personalized treatment strategies. This paper presents the preliminary results of the PrediHealth research project conducted in this context.

arxiv-2602-02887.title: From Accessibility to Allocation: An Integrated Workflow for Land-Use Assignment and FAR Estimation
arxiv-2602-02887.creator: Yue Sun, Ryan Weightman, Yang Yang, Anye Shi, Timur Dogan, Samitha Samaranayake
arxiv-2602-02887.description: Abstract Urban land use and building intensity are often planned without a direct, auditable link to network accessibility, limiting ex-ante policy evaluation. This study asks whether multi-radius street centralities can be elevated from diagnosis to design lever to allocate land use and floor area in a transparent, optimization-ready workflow.

pmc-10603688.creator: Aixin Hu, Wenxia Huang, Xin Shu, Shiyue Ma, Caimei Yang, Ruiqiang Zhang, Xiao Xiao, Yanping Wu
pmc-10603688.description: Simple SummarySalmonella infection is an urgent problem in animal husbandry, which causes salmonellosis in livestock and poses threats to human health through contaminated livestock products. As an alternative to antibiotics, probiotics play an important role in maintaining animal health. However, some probiotics, such as lactic acid bacteria, have limitations in storage and hostile environments.

pmc-10736250.title: PERCEIVED STRAIN ON THE SPOUSAL RELATIONSHIP AMONG MARRIED CUSTODIAL GRANDPARENTS WITHIN THE PARENTING ROLE
pmc-10736250.creator: Eunbea Kim, Jeong Eun Lee, Gregory Smith
pmc-10736250.description: Providing primary care for grandchildren is known to have a significant impact on custodial grandparents’ well-being. For married custodial grandparents, although their caregiving burden may spill over to marriage which can lead to negative psychological outcomes, it has rarely been examined.

pmc-11644240.title: Click Chemistry for Well-Defined Graft Copolymers
pmc-11644240.creator: Muhammad Faizan Ali, Bungo Ochiai
pmc-11644240.description: Graft copolymers have gained significant importance in various fields due to their tunable functionality and well-defined architecture. However, there are still limitations due to the compatibility of monomers and functional groups depending on the polymerization mode. Click chemistry has solved this problem through its ability to easily and quantitatively link a wide range of polymers and functional groups.

pmc-12610761.title: Intima–Media Thickening with Carotid Webs: A Case Report of a Potentially High-Risk Association
pmc-12610761.creator: Corrado Tagliati, Alessia Quaranta, Marco Fogante, Claudio Ventura, Stefania Lamja, Alfonso Alberto Matarrese, Pierpaolo Palumbo, Iacopo Carbone, Ernesto Di Cesare, Gabriele Polonara, Nicolò Schicchi, Sophie Mavrogeni, Nagara Tamaki
pmc-12610761.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). We describe a case of an asymptomatic 70-year-old female patient on whom a carotid ultrasound examination was performed that showed intima–media thickening and a 4 mm long carotid web with a 50% web-to-bulb ratio. Spectral Doppler waveform demonstrated a turbulent flow pattern and a peak systolic velocity increase of 100% (velocity ratio = 2) when compared with the common carotid artery.

pmc-13623564.title: Glocalizing medical education through community clinical experiences: a model for socially accountable preclinical, community-based training
pmc-13623564.creator: Rashida Daisley, Leslie S. Craig, Cordelle Lazare, Carlene Radix, Rhonda McIntyre
pmc-13623564.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Calls for “glocalization” in health professions education reflect growing expectations that global educational standards are meaningfully aligned with local priorities, in keeping with social accountability principles and shared values of relevance, equity, quality and cost-effectiveness. At the same time, increasing attention to the role of social determinants in shaping health outcomes challenges medical institutions to prepare practice-ready physicians who are culturally responsive and well-equipped to deliver holistic, patient-centered care.

uslaw-usc-t10-s9381.title: 10 U.S.C. § 9381 — Fatality reviews
uslaw-usc-t10-s9381.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t10-s9381.description: United States Code, Title 10 (Armed Forces); Part II (Personnel); Chapter 949 (Miscellaneous Investigation Requirements And Other Duties). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Review of Fatalities.— The Secretary of the Air Force shall conduct a multidisciplinary, impartial review (referred to as a “fatality review”) in the case of each fatality known or suspected to have resulted from domestic violence or child.
